role: Frozen v30 and official Hi ESP independent AMI dialogue preregistration
selection: v30 was previously selected from development data and remains exactly frozen. v31 rejected on completed development results; no Nyx model update or threshold selection from any independent final outcomes. This is an additional fixed-model domain test, not a new candidate search.
protocol: Commit and push before first inference. Complete all16 meetings for both engines irrespective of early events. Same prepared16kPCM16, reset only between meetings; retain native triggers and original Nyx5-score float64 smoothing/latch/refractory. Count every event including startup/tail padding. Exposure is original PCM only; no added gaps. Per-engine pooled AMI one-sided95% Poisson upper bound<=0.5/h is the primary numerical negative criterion; also report all four repeated-participant meeting groups with their own bounds. Do not combine previous LibriSpeech exposure to rescue an AMI failure. Any runtime failure yields no subset quality summary. Never filter sources, change labels, tune thresholds/models or rerun a candidate based on final outcomes. Future candidate acceptance needs fresh independent data.
limits: Far-field dialogue negatives only.16 recurring people across four meeting groups; nominal Poisson bounds do not account for dependence, nonstationarity or deployment population shift. Literal transcript screen is not exhaustive phonetic truth. No matched population FAR, positive recall, phonetic latency, MCU numeric/cycle/power or full-goal acceptance conclusion, even if the numerical bound passes. This AMI set becomes scored after this run and must not be reused as untouched acceptance data.
